title: The sticky-note inventory
caption:
POV: your inventory system is a wall of sticky notes.

Note 12 says "38 units, maybe 41?" and the mug is warehouse 2.

There's a better way, and it's not another sticky note. Tag a colleague with a sticky-note wall, or book a meeting with our team. Link in bio.

lines.vo: Point of view: your inventory system is a wall of sticky notes.
Note twelve says: thirty-eight units, maybe forty-one. And the mug? The mug is warehouse two.
There's a better way. And it's not another sticky note.
Your stock, always in sight. Book a meeting with our team.

notes: Originally a filmed handheld reel; produced as an animated reel with sticky-note cards.
